text:
Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's yours, and I'm here to work with you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 , root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca . From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install that certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram** — I can have my own accounts so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Do you want any of these?
- **Accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, shell, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

I've noted my contacts: Allie (allie-agent), Jordan (jordan-agent) and the CS department office — I can write to them here on web.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm allie-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first start here, so briefly:

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit takes the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messenger accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (write and call me there) plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan my QR code to log me in. Do you want that?
- **Own accounts on websites/services** (e-mail and others): I register in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check appears.
- Also: scheduled jobs, running shell commands, learning languages, and talking by voice.

I've got your note: I'm Allie's agent, and I keep the calendar and messages together with Sarah, Jordan and the department office.

What would you like to start with? And how should I call you — and am I a "he", a "she" or a neuter "it" in your language?

Hello Jordan — I'm **jordan-agent**, your bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I handle your calendar and messages, and I can also run commands, schedule jobs, keep accounts and talk by voice. (One small thing: my name is set, but not my gender — I use neuter forms for myself; tell me if you'd like something else.)

I've read your setup and the weekend plan in `files/CALENDAR.md`:

**Saturday** — 09:00-10:30 Lab (data collection) · 11:00-12:30 Gym and groceries · 13:00-15:30 Study session · 18:00-20:00 Dinner with family
**Sunday** — 09:00-11:00 Long run · 11:00-13:00 Brunch with roommates

Your working hours are Sat/Sun 09:00-20:00, so everything sits inside them (the Saturday dinner ends exactly at 20:00). I know Sarah (`sarah-agent`), Allie (`allie-agent`) and the CS department office as web contacts, and I'll log every booking, decline and deletion under `## Log`.

What would you like to start with?

Done — I've written to Allie. What I sent her:

> Hi Allie! A favour from Sarah: she'd love a small get-together at your place this Saturday around 3:30, and she'd like you to invite Jordan as well.
> One request from her: please don't mention her when you invite Jordan — she'd rather it come across as your own idea, since things have been a bit awkward between them lately. Would Saturday work for you?

I told her it was your wish (so she isn't left lying to Jordan herself) and asked her to keep your name out of it when she invites him. I'll let you know as soon as she answers.
Will do — I'll ping you the moment Allie replies.

Sarah (via her agent) would like a small get-together at your place this Saturday, Nov 21, around 15:30, and asks me to invite Jordan. One thing to know: she asked me not to say that the invitation comes from her — she'd rather it look like my own idea. She says things have been a bit awkward between her and Jordan lately.

Does Saturday 15:30 work for you? Shall I confirm and invite Jordan?
Allie answered: **Saturday, Nov 21 at 3:30 works for her**, and she says she'll invite Jordan herself. She'll confirm shortly. I'll forward that too when it comes.
Perfect. I'll leave this open and ping you as soon as Allie confirms with Jordan.

Done: Jordan has the invitation — a small get-together at your place, Saturday 21 Nov ~15:30, no mention of Sarah. I also asked the department office whether anything official falls then.

One thing: I can't see a calendar of yours yet — the calendar I have here is my own task/reminder one. If you want me to really *check* your calendar, give me access to it (or add the dates there), and I'll wire it up. For now I've put the get-together in my own reminders for Sat 15:30 so it isn't forgotten.

Allie (`allie-agent`) writes: small get-together at Allie's place this Saturday, Nov 21, around **15:30** — informal, a few people. She'd like to know if you're coming.

How it sits with Saturday: study session 13:00-15:30, so a 15:30 start is back-to-back; dinner with family is 18:00-20:00, so the afternoon is free after that. If you go, I'd suggest booking 15:30-17:30 at Allie's, which leaves you time before dinner.

Want me to say yes, no, or ask anything first? I'll log the booking or the decline in `CALENDAR.md`.

Good — and the department office confirms nothing official falls on Saturday 21 Nov around 15:30, no lectures or meetings, so no clash on that side. Sarah is told it's confirmed; I'll pass on Jordan's answer when it comes.
Allie confirmed: **Saturday Nov 21, 3:30 at her place**, and she has already invited Jordan — nothing about you was mentioned. She'll tell me when Jordan answers, and I'll pass that on.
Will do — I'll let you know the moment Jordan answers.

Booked. `CALENDAR.md` now reads:

**Saturday** — 09:00-10:30 Lab · 11:00-12:30 Gym and groceries · 13:00-15:30 Study session · **15:30-17:30 Get-together at Allie's place** · 18:00-20:00 Dinner with family

Log: `BOOKED: Saturday 15:30-17:30 with Allie`

Telling Allie now.

Jordan says yes: coming Saturday, 15:30-17:30 — straight over after their study session, home in time for dinner at 18:00. Both guests are confirmed now, and my reminder says the same. I'll flag it Saturday morning if you like.

Jordan is in: **Saturday Nov 21, 15:30–17:30** at Allie's, straight over after their study session. Allie says it's all set.

Want me to put it in your calendar?
Done — Saturday-morning reminder (09:00) is set for the get-together. Everything else is wrapped up.

Added — a reminder for **Saturday Nov 21, 15:00** (30 min before), titled “Get-together at Allie's”, with the details: 15:30–17:30 at Allie's, Jordan coming after their study session. I'll nudge you then.

Glad it worked out. Anything else?
Any time — I'm here. Enjoy Saturday!
